Container.Name: birdsong
Container.Overview:
Birdsong shows the birds your BirdNET-Go station has heard as a single plate of hand-cut 1800s illustrations, each bird sized by how often it called. Select a bird for its plate, a short description, its calls by hour and by day, and its latest recordings with playback.
Requires a running BirdNET-Go. Set its address below, then open the WebUI. The artwork is built into the image; the image is rebuilt weekly to pick up new birds.
Container.Requires: BirdNET-Go, installed separately and reachable from this container.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port the Birdsong page is served on.

Config.Name: BirdNET-Go address
Config.Description: Address of your BirdNET-Go, with http:// and its port, for example http://192.168.1.50:8080. Use the server's IP, not localhost.

Config.Name: Tailscale state
Config.Description: Optional, only used with Unraid's per-container Tailscale: a persistent folder so Birdsong keeps its tailnet identity across updates. If you enable Tailscale on this container, set its 'Tailscale State Directory' to /tailscale.
